name: Villayerno Morquillas (Spain)
description: Square red flag with a yellow bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villayerno Morquillas (a castle and a crozier on red).
history: Municipal flag of Villayerno Morquillas; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
